title: Desk Dashboard: WiFi Ambient Display
description: Engineered a single-cable WiFi desk display end-to-end: firmware, power electronics, and a 3D-printed enclosure
Wrote a custom MicroPython display driver for a 480x320 SPI IPS panel
Merged live weather and calendar data across four auto-refreshing screens
Root-caused a post-deployment power failure through current-budget analysis

title: HAROLD: x86 Operating System
description: Built a 32-bit x86 OS from scratch: bootloader handoff, preemptive scheduler, and FAT16 filesystem
Hand-rolled a TCP/IP stack (ARP/IP/ICMP/UDP/TCP) with RFC 6298 adaptive retransmission
Ships a 19-syscall ABI, custom libc, shell, and 22 userspace programs
Includes a mouse-driven GUI and a from-scratch neural net that runs inference with zero floating-point hardware

title: Haptic Feedback VR Glove
description: Senior capstone project: a VR glove with real-time haptic and thermal feedback
Built BLE firmware on dual ESP32-S3 microcontrollers with bidirectional communication and automatic reconnection
Custom multi-command packet parser controlling 10 vibration motors and 2 Peltier thermal tiles, synced with Unity

title: Autonomous Oxygen Management System
description: 1st Place winner, IEEE ProfHackathon (Track 3: Outlaws & Automation)
Python-controlled PLC simulating a space habitat oxygen tank
Autonomously responds to demand fluctuations via a real-time Serial/Modbus control loop
Adjusts motor output through a Variable Frequency Drive

title: RAG API with Automated Quality Testing
description: FastAPI REST API implementing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
Queries ChromaDB for nearest-neighbor context retrieval and augments prompts
Generates responses via a local Ollama (tinyllama) LLM
GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline running automated semantic regression tests on every push
